name: Free City of Frankfurt
alt: Free City of Frankfurt am Main

predecessors.name: Grand Duchy of Frankfurt
predecessors.text: the city of Frankfurt, capital of Dalberg's Grand Duchy

successors.name: Kingdom of Prussia
successors.text: the city and its territory, annexed to Prussia and made part of the Province of Hesse-Nassau

ledger.x: 1815: Frankfurt is restored as a free city.
1866: the Free City of Frankfurt ends on 20 September 1866 with the Prussian decree of annexation.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War (occupation of Frankfurt)
wars.outcome: Prussia took the undefended city on 16 July 1866 and annexed it on 20 September 1866.

certainty.note: A city-state whose territory the page itemises (city district, eight villages, forest district of 4,480 ha); no survey line is dated, so sharp rests on the administrative record.
